rationale: PINS the declared-type reference graph: constructor params, properties, function params, return types, as-casts and is-checks each emit References to every named type; generics expand; nullable wrappers descend. M37 KAD3 adds the extension-receiver pin (receiver_type wrapper node); M37 KAD6 pins the return-type SOURCE (the declaring function, never Global).

expectRelationships.comment: KAD6: return-type edges source to the declaring function (pre-fix: top-level fns sourced to Global)
KAD3: the extension RECEIVER type emits its reference (grammar wraps it in receiver_type — the user_type-only walk never matched, so no edge pre-fix; return_type pin below is separate)

forbidRelationships.comment: KAD6: no declaration-position reference may source to the Global placeholder
